の	助詞,連体化,*,*,*	の	ノ	8	11
日	名詞,一般,*,*,*	日	ニチ	12	15

==== parse error: bounded alt quantifier ====
(seq (alt (m surface "氏") (m surface "さん")) :0-16)
---- error Bad_Quantifier

==== parse error: alt :3 has max 3 ====
(seq (alt (m surface "氏") (m surface "さん")) :3)
---- error Bad_Quantifier

==== parse error: alt branch with min 0 ====
(seq (alt (m _ :0-1) (m _)) :*)
---- error Bad_Quantifier

==== parse error: mixed-any under a bounded quant ====
(seq (m pos (any ^"名詞," ^"動詞,") :0-2))
---- error Bad_Quantifier

==== parse error: fuzzy distance past 3 ====
(seq (m lemma (fuzzy "少ない" :4)))
---- error Bad_Quantifier

==== parse error: bounded quant max past 64 ====
(seq (m _ :0-100000))
---- error Bad_Quantifier

==== parse error: quant max below min ====
(seq (m _ :5-2))
---- error Bad_Quantifier

==== parse error: _ as a value ====
(seq (m lemma _))
---- error Bad_Value

==== parse error: unknown field ====
(seq (m nosuch "x"))
---- error Unknown_Field

==== parse error: ~ with no groups registered ====
(seq (m lemma ~"見る"))
---- error No_Group

==== parse error: % with no proc registered ====
(seq (m reading %"nope"))
---- error No_Custom

==== parse error: same field twice ====
(seq (m lemma "走る" lemma "走る"))
---- error Bad_Syntax

==== parse error: quant on not! ====
(seq (m surface "氏") (not! (m pos ^"助詞,")) :?)
---- error Bad_Syntax

==== parse error: capture on not! ====
(seq (m surface "氏") (not! (m pos ^"助詞,")) @a)
---- error Bad_Syntax

==== parse error: capture on nothing ====
(seq @a (m _))
---- error Bad_Syntax

==== parse error: capture inside alt ====
(seq (alt (m _) @a (m _)))
---- error Bad_Syntax

==== parse error: $ before ^ ====
(seq $ ^ (m _))
---- error Bad_Syntax

==== parse error: empty seq ====
(seq)
---- error Bad_Syntax

==== parse error: truncated source ====
(seq (m surface "氏")
---- error Bad_Syntax

==== parse error: unterminated string ====
(seq (m surface "未閉))
---- error Bad_Syntax

==== parse error: trailing junk ====
(seq (m _)) junk
---- error Bad_Syntax

==== parse error: second quant site ====
(seq (m _ :0-2) :0-2)
---- error Bad_Syntax

==== parse error: nested alt branch ====
(seq (alt (alt (m _) (m _)) (m _)))
---- error Bad_Syntax

==== parse error: not of alt ====
(seq (not (alt (m _) (m _))))
---- error Bad_Syntax

==== parse error: quant not last inside m ====
(seq (m :0-2 _))
---- error Bad_Syntax
